text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The book cover Still-san gave me has such 
cool red feather embroidery on it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I put one on a book, it feels 
like it turns it into something truly 
special. It makes my heart flutter every 
single time...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm just happy I could add a splash 
of color to your reading time, Rob 
Roy-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The bookmark you gave me is truly 
wonderful too, Alv-san, with that iris 
engraving...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Because it's made of metal, the engraving 
glimmers every time you open the book. 
It's so mystical and gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. If I'm not in the way, then 
that's fine."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's hardly an adequate return, but... 
next time, please let me pick out a book 
that each of you might enjoy...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-Well, the gift from the two of you 
felt so respectful towards books... I 
figured we were fellow book lovers, so 
without thinking...――

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. ...I'll at least hear you out 
on what you picked."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! Leave it to me...! I will absolutely 
find the perfect book for you...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Such passionate eyes... I'm 
looking forward to it as well...
